notes.title: V 0.3.0 Update
notes.notes:
This update adds a new mode: Alone Mode
In this mode, all competitors disappear, leaving only you to survive alone, of course, all the resources belong to you.
You can finally manage their own animal populations in various regions, rather than an empty area to take over after defeating their opponents.

notes.title: V0.2.0 Update log，New Game Mode~
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36865614/ce2881ee9eefce90493fcebc1b5ca576e513bdfb.png

This update mainly added a new game mode "Anomalous Mode".

The inspiration of this mode is also from many players' suggestions. Thank you for your support.

--The new "Anomalous Mode", which has no regular seasonal cycle, changes randomly every time, and has different challenges of bad weather each time. I hope it can bring you a new game experience.

--Fix some bugs.

This update took a long time, mainly because I am the only one to develop, the development speed is very slow, I hope you understand.

notes.title: V0.1.33 Update Log, Halloween~
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36865614/b21204ca524a95d7759b6b433165d1d49a594bef.jpg

With the advent of Halloween, there will be more supernatural events in the game world. For example, you will encounter some ghosts when hunting at night. Be careful! These ghosts are different from those in the basement. They can be aggressive and damage your mental value.

But don't be afraid. Releasing the fox can disperse the ghost

In addition, a new game mode is under development！

notes.title: Update log V0.1.32
notes.notes:
--The hunting area will encounter new NPCs at random. You can choose to ask them for items, or you can release them. Robbing them frequently will reduce the probability of meeting them. Try not to kill them or you will never see them again.

---Increase the types of thieves. Some thieves may appear randomly in a certain location in the hunting area. Players can sneak past and sneak attack.

--The fox can be caught. After catching it, it can be slaughtered as other small animals. It can also be released in the hunting area. The released fox will become a woman.

--Fix some UI display problems.

notes.title: Update log V0.1.31
notes.notes:
--The function of setting the number of items to be thrown away from the bag is added. When the number of items is more than 1, the quantity can be set.

--Add some operation guidance (for the players who open the game for the first time, the old players will not see it)

--Fixed hunter's dog interaction button sometimes blocked by the building and could not be selected

--Fixed the bug that the ore reserves are sometimes initially zero

notes.title: Update log V0.1.30
notes.notes:
--In the "Eastern swamp" of the swamp area, a basement is added. In the basement, you will meet an old man. You can choose to play coin guessing games with him. If you are lucky, you can win more valuable resources.
--In the "western suburbs" of the city area, a basement is added. In the basement, you will meet a beautiful female ecologist. You can choose to get along with her and help her solve her problems. Of course, when the intimacy reaches a certain degree, she will also help you.
--Fixed a bug in the production of sugar beets and sugarcane that could not accumulate when cooked at the same time.
--Fixed a bug where the value of the product was zero at the time of trading.
--Fixed a bug in which animals jump left and right when they encounter aggressive animals after using skunk.
--Fixed the bug of "unable to stand up" by pressing ESC key occasionally when logging and mining
--When mining, logging and reclamation, when attacked by animals, the collection will be automatically interrupted.

notes.title: Update log V0.1.29
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!
Recently, many players think that logging and mining mouse click is too frequent, and the operation is not convenient. I urgently updated the function of continuous logging and quarrying.
In the Options panel, you can find the "continuous mine/ log" option and check it. Then you can continue logging and mining . During logging and mining , press ESC to stop!

notes.title: Update log V0.1.28
notes.notes: Fix some bugs in the game!

notes.title: Update log V0.1.27
notes.notes:
--Add greenhouse buildings can be built in the camp to plant crops. In cold seasons, fuel can be used to heat the plants to keep growing. The greenhouse temperature level can be set to adjust the growth rate of plants. Of course, the higher the temperature level, the faster the fuel consumption.

--Add construction location again.

--Optimizing the training probability and reducing the difficulty of horse training in the later stage.

--Helen's archery quickened.

--Reduce the difficulty of trap making and reduce the probability of damage.

--Increased number of items brought back by miners' NPC.

--Fix the bug that the range of some hidden points is too small.

--Fix the bug that horse health value does not recover.

notes.title: Update log V0.1.26
notes.notes: Fix some bugs in the game！

notes.title: Update log V0.1.25
notes.notes: Fixed some bugs in the game

notes.title: Update log V0.1.24
notes.notes:
--When logging and quarrying, the time velocity slows down, and the time is no longer accelerated, but normal time passes
--During reclamation, the flow rate of time slows down, and the normal time passes instead of accelerating
--Rest for more sleep

notes.title: Update log V0.1.23
notes.notes:
Added build locations. Now you can build all facilities in the base. More build locations and facilities will be added later, such as greenhouse which allows you to plant in the base.
 Adjusted the lightning strike probability, you will not be struck by the lightning continuously.
 Increased the durability of the crowbar, you can use it more times.
 Warn longer in advance that the body temperature is too high or too low.
 Open the game menu next to the fire (when the time is paused), the body temperature can still be restored.
 Optimized the performance issues of mountain scenes.
 Fixed several bugs.


In addition to adding new content in the future, we will continue to optimize values, controls, and guidance issues.

notes.title: Thank you for your support, here’s the upcoming update plan
notes.notes:
Hi survival experts,

The Rule of Land: Pioneers has released for two days. First of all, we want to thank you for your support.

Based on the players feedback at this stage, I will focus on adding more content for existing game modes in the next 2-3 weeks updates. After this, new fun game modes will be added to the game.

The following updates will include:

 Add new buildable facilities and build locations, including greenhouse that player can plant in camps.
 Enrich the background plot of each game mode.
 Based on players feedback, optimize some of the functions with poor experience.
 Expand the plot-related gameplay. There will be more interaction between player and NPC, they can help you survive while your action may decide their destiny. You can also learn more about the world settings through them.


Since the game is in Early Access stage, all the updates will be totally free. If you have any thoughts or suggestions on the game, please feel free to tell me, thanks!
